sentences.text:
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 7 Others Counsel for Petitioner :- Shamsuddin Ahmad Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Anjani Kumar Mishra,J.
Hon'ble Prakash Padia,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Standing Counsel, who has obtained instructions in pursuance of the order passed earlier.

The petitioner seeks following relief:-
" ( a ) I s s u e a w r i t , o r d e r o r d i r e c t i o n i n t h e n a t u r e o f m a n d a m u s commanding/directing the concerned respondent/licensing authority to grant license of petitioner for business/retailer shop of Buffalo meat as per Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 as well as Food Safety and Standings (Licensing and Registrations of Food Business), Regulations, 2011"
M/S Faisal Meat Shop vs State Of U.P. And 7 Others on 7 December, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/16043597/
1

entities.text: Faisal Meat Shop vs State Of U.P. And 7 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The submission of learned Standing Counsel is that the application filed by the petitioner contains defects.
He has also submitted no objection certificate required from the Police authorities has not been uploaded online by petitioner.
Under the circumstances, no direction are required to issue in the matter as the petitioner may complete the formalities and remove defects in his online application form.
Once that is done, it is expected that the authorities shall proceed and decide the matter expeditiously.
Subject to the above, the petition stands disposed of.

Order Date :- 7.12.2020 saqlain  M/S Faisal Meat Shop vs State Of U.P. And 7 Others on 7 December, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/16043597/
